register.labelZh: GET (VOLUME 2) 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: GET 可以清楚表示某物是過河、下樓梯、搬上舞台、越過障礙,還是返回原來的地方。；get somebody through 可以描述有人提供支持,幫助另一個人捱過艱難的一星期、一年、課程或經歷。；get something across 適合用來談論解釋重點、傳達想法,以及令其他人明白某件事。；你可以用 GET 表達收拾物品、取回東西、吞藥,以及叫某人過來等常見情況。
register.summaryEn: GET can show whether something moves across a river, down some stairs, onto a stage, past an obstacle or back to its original place. Get somebody through can describe the support that helps someone survive a difficult week, year, course or experience. Get something across is useful when talking about explaining a point, communicating an idea or making other people understand something. You can use GET when collecting your things, getting something back, swallowing medicine or calling somebody to come over.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；有些 GET 表達看起來相似,但表示不同類型的移動。請仔細閱讀整個情境。For example:get the boxes across the river把箱子運過河get the box down the stairs把箱子搬下樓梯get the piano onto the stage把鋼琴搬上舞台get the buggy past the car把嬰兒車推過停泊的汽車；在 get it back、get it down 和 get it across 等表達中,請按照例句使用自然的語序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Some expressions look similar but describe different kinds of movement. Read the whole situation carefully. In expressions such as get it back, get it down and get it across, keep the complete expression together naturally as shown in the examples.
